project.title: Pathfinder 2e Attribute Calculator
project.summary: Browser calculator for Pathfinder 2e Remaster attribute modifiers with a live ledger and shareable builds.

items.title: Extend build tests for remaining normalize and calculate edge cases
items.notes: Cover voluntary flaw caps, empty background remaining counts, and milestone filtering beyond the current dwarf-druid suite.

items.title: Add carefully sourced ancestry, background, or class rows beyond Player Core 2
items.notes: Keep custom entry for unsupported books; only add presets the project is willing to maintain. Assumption: expansion is optional, not required for Remaster correctness.

items.title: Improve print stylesheet so the ledger is readable on paper
items.notes: README already offers print; tighten layout for single-page output without changing calculate semantics.

items.title: Audit keyboard and screen-reader flow for boost choice controls
items.notes: Choice buttons already expose aria-pressed; verify focus order, labels, and flaw details across a full build.

items.title: Surface clearer recovery when port 3001 is already bound
items.notes: dev uses --strictPort; document or fail with an actionable message so first-run failures are obvious.
